title: Taking a recruiter screening call
objectives: Explain why you are looking for a new role
Confirm hybrid availability and ask about next steps

courseTemplate.setting: The candidate has four years of e-commerce analytics experience, wants more ownership and can work on-site twice a week.

roles.learner: A data analyst speaking with a recruiter
roles.partner: A recruiter filling a senior analyst role

courseTemplate.openingLine: Thanks for your interest in the senior analyst role. Tell me a bit about your experience.

targetPatterns.pattern: I've worked as a data analyst for four years, mostly in e-commerce.
targetPatterns.example: I've worked as a data analyst for four years, mostly in e-commerce.

targetPatterns.pattern: I'd like more ownership so I can help decide what the team works on.
targetPatterns.example: I'd like more ownership so I can help decide what the team works on.

targetPatterns.pattern: Yes, I can work on-site twice a week. What does the interview process look like?
targetPatterns.example: Yes, I can work on-site twice a week. What does the interview process look like?

targetPatterns.pattern: I have five years of experience in product management.
targetPatterns.example: I have five years of experience in product management.
targetPatterns.translation: 我有五年产品管理经验。

targetPatterns.pattern: I saw your job posting on LinkedIn.
targetPatterns.example: I saw your job posting on LinkedIn.
targetPatterns.translation: 我在 LinkedIn 上看到了你们的职位。

targetPatterns.pattern: My strength is turning vague requirements into clear specs.
targetPatterns.example: My strength is turning vague requirements into clear specs.
targetPatterns.translation: 我的强项是把模糊需求变成清晰规格。

targetPatterns.pattern: Could you tell me more about the team structure?
targetPatterns.example: Could you tell me more about the team structure?
targetPatterns.translation: 能介绍一下团队结构吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm currently serving my notice period.
targetPatterns.example: I'm currently serving my notice period.

targetPatterns.pattern: What does the interview process look like?
targetPatterns.example: What does the interview process look like?

targetPatterns.pattern: My expected salary range is 40 to 50 thousand a month.
targetPatterns.example: My expected salary range is 40 to 50 thousand a month.
targetPatterns.translation: 我的期望月薪范围是 4 万到 5 万。

targetPatterns.pattern: Could I get the job description in writing?
targetPatterns.example: Could I get the job description in writing?
targetPatterns.translation: 能发我一份书面的职位描述吗？

stages.title: Summarize relevant experience
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Thanks for your interest in the senior analyst role. Tell me a bit about your experience.”
successCriteria: The learner can summarize relevant experience in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I've worked as a …”

stages.title: Explain why you are looking for a new role
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “What are you looking for in your next role?”
successCriteria: The learner can explain why you are looking for a new role in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I'd like more ownership …”

stages.title: Confirm hybrid availability and ask about next steps
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Would a hybrid schedule work for you?”
successCriteria: The learner can confirm hybrid availability and ask about next steps in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Yes, I can work …”

learningPack.overview: 求职准备 · The candidate has four years of e-commerce analytics experience, wants more ownership and can work on-site twice a week.

scenarioFacts.label: Roleplay facts
scenarioFacts.value: The candidate has four years of e-commerce analytics experience, wants more ownership and can work on-site twice a week.

vocabulary.example: I saw your job posting on LinkedIn.
I'm currently serving my notice period.
I've worked as a data analyst for four years, mostly in e-commerce.
I'd like more ownership so I can help decide what the team works on.
Would a hybrid schedule work for you?

languageNotes: 介绍经验用 I have X years of experience，不要说 "I have five years working"；「离职」主动是 resign，被裁是 laid off，语境完全不同。

warmup.prompt: Say this in English. 我有五年产品管理经验。
warmup.suggestedAnswer: I have five years of experience in product management.

modelDialogue.text: Thanks for your interest in the senior analyst role. Tell me a bit about your experience.
I've worked as a data analyst for four years, mostly in e-commerce.
What are you looking for in your next role?
I'd like more ownership so I can help decide what the team works on.
Would a hybrid schedule work for you?
Yes, I can work on-site twice a week. What does the interview process look like?
